feed_summary: A Belarus-aligned hacktivist group spent nearly two years within the network of a Russian healthcare organization. According to a report published by Russian cybersecurity firm Solar, the activity has been attributed to a threat cluster dubbed Partisan Zmiy, which is also known as the Cyber Partisans. title: Hackers Hid Vasilek Backdoor in VMware Tools During 2-Year Russian Healthcare Intrusion
